name: Boulder'gor
summary: Boulder'gor commands western Arathi, north of Stromgarde, where Boulderfist ogres and Witherbark trolls share an encampment.

sections.title: A Den of Ogres and Trolls
sections.body: North of Stromgarde Keep’s crumbling ramparts, Boulder'gor rises above the central roads of Arathi. The Boulderfist Outpost mound stands among its shadows, a stronghold of ogre power across the highlands. Boulderfist ogres share fires and fortifications with Witherbark forest trolls. Their shadowy spellcasters add dark magic to the clan’s brute force, and together they endanger travelers on the roads.

sections.title: Surrounding Territory
sections.body: From Boulder'gor’s slopes, you can look across the open highlands of western Arathi. The hill lies between Stromgarde’s Syndicate-infiltrated ruins and the plains’ wild elemental sites. Heavily guarded and hostile, Boulder'gor remains a tribal stronghold against Alliance and Horde wanderers.

faq.answer: Boulder'gor rises as a hill and encampment north of Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands. Boulderfist ogres and Witherbark forest trolls hold it in force.

faq.q: Why are forest trolls living alongside ogres here?
faq.answer: The Witherbark trolls and Boulderfist ogres maintain a pragmatic alliance in Arathi. Both seek dominance over the highlands and aim to fend off rival factions, joining troll shadowcraft with brute ogre strength.

faq.q: What major landmarks are near Boulder'gor?
faq.answer: Boulder'gor lies directly north of Stromgarde Keep. Boulderfist Outpost’s ogre mound stands within the hill.

faq.q: Is Boulder'gor friendly to the Horde or Alliance?
faq.answer: Neither faction is welcome. Boulderfist ogres and Witherbark trolls aggressively defend Boulder'gor from Alliance and Horde outsiders.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you will find no kinship with the Witherbark forest trolls of Boulder'gor. They hold ancient grudges against outsiders, even other troll tribes.
As an Alliance soldier seeking to reclaim Stromgarde, you face a serious threat at Boulder'gor, on the fallen kingdom’s northern doorstep.
